description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: lib/zaq/engine/connect/credential.ex, grant.ex, connect.ex changeset entry points, priv/repo/migrations/*, test/zaq/engine/connect/* schema/migration tests. Read moduledocs before edits. Add personal_credential_policy Ecto.Enum disabled/optional/required with database default disabled, NOT NULL and CHECK. Keep user_level unrelated. Introduce explicit credential binding versus existing resource binding (binding_type default resource for existing rows); canonical rows have no resource pair, legacy rows require both. Allow person ownership with dedicated person_id FK, owner_id equality CHECK and non-null person identity; legacy org/user remain compatible. Canonical org owner_id must be NULL. Partial unique indexes enforce one canonical person grant per credential/person and one canonical org grant per credential, regardless of status. Retain revoked/expired row; reconnection replaces current row. Reject ambiguous canonical user ownership until separately specified; existing user resource grants remain supported. Grant provider/auth_kind/request_format and scopes derive from credential, not client attrs. Determine the smallest explicit canonical credential mode necessary to allow JWT credentials without configuration-level private keys while retaining legacy JWT validation; document that distinction rather than overloading user_level or policy.

Tests to add before implementation: migration on representative existing rows; unchanged legacy issue/list/resolve behavior; policy default/invalid enum; person FK and mismatched owner checks; NULL global uniqueness; concurrent inserts using independent committed connections; revoked/expired rows still occupy slot; canonical versus resource binding rejects mixed/partial inputs; authentication fields cannot disagree with configuration; required JWT can store grant-owned key material.

Branches/paths validated: all three auth kinds; org/user legacy; person canonical; absent Person; deleted credential; duplicate statuses; migration retry and rollback constraints with personal data present. Refuse destructive down migration while canonical grants exist rather than silently losing secrets.

Mocking plan: none; real Ecto/PostgreSQL and encryption storage. Race tests use isolated data and explicit cleanup, not shared global sandbox mutation. Dependencies: Repo, migration runner and encryption config existing seams.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/: schema moduledocs/types; docs/services/engine.md storage ownership and compatibility; docs/services/system-config.md distinction between configuration and grant secrets. Done: additive migration, tested rollback policy, no AI/schema consumer changes, no provider-wide uniqueness, >=95% changed application-file coverage.
title: [zaq-jrg.1] 1. Add canonical credential-bound grant storage
